column3: “stood against him” renders “stood over him”; “plead” and “contend” render the same verb.
“he named him” renders the impersonal “someone called him”; NASB adds “that is to say.” “Jerubbaal” means “Let Baal contend.”
“came upon” renders “clothed”; “trumpet” renders “ram’s horn,” and “the Abiezrites” renders “Abiezer.”
